title: Cloud Hypervisor enclave storage inherits shared mount propagation
conditions: Cloud Hypervisor host enclave storage is beneath a shared allocation parent or separate shared invocation destination
For the invocation case, sourceBeforeBind is private, destinationBeforeBind is shared, and invocationVerified is [1,1,1,0] while other verified roles are private
A generic storage-mount-propagation reason alone does not distinguish shared, missing or ambiguous entries
rootCause: Nested binds in an overlapping shared allocation can propagate duplicate mounts. Independently, a private state source bound beneath a shared external destination inherits shared propagation; privatizing only the allocation does not privatize that destination bind.

probe.expect: As the owning host operator, read only the bounded startup-error descriptor projection. One exact shared invocation entry distinguishes destination inheritance from missing or duplicate matches. Collected startup.json preserves the checklist but can omit topology/propagation; absence is unknown.

action: Use source containing both allocation-private and invocation-state-private fixes, with release-matched trusted artifacts. Current code verifies the journal, privatizes only the captured mount and rechecks exact identity/options. Never change host-wide propagation, choose a topmost duplicate, or relax cleanup. Fixed source does not prove a released version or guest acceptance.

references.title: Invocation destination fix and v0.28.44 evidence
Privileged Linux cases; not macOS acceptance
